definitions.explanation: A number of animals or birds gathered together.
A large number of people gathered together.

examples.english: A flock of birds is flying.

examples.japanese: ⟦{羊|ひつじ}→羊：04713_hitsuji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{群|む}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{追|お}いながら→追う：02016_ou⟧⟦{牧場|ぼくじょう}→牧場：06103_bokujou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}いた→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: I walked through the ranch while following the herd of sheep.

examples.japanese: ⟦{観光客|かんこうきゃく}→観光客：03022_kankoukyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{群|む}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訪|おとず}れた→訪れる：07678_otozureru⟧。
examples.english: A crowd of tourists visited the shrine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{帰宅|きたく}する→帰宅：02546_kitaku⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{群|む}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できていた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: There was a crowd of people heading home in front of the station.

notes:
{群|む}れ refers to groups of animals or people gathered together.
